title: Cloud Security: billing calendar
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for billing calendar.

## Basis

Billing timezone: Timezone used for calendar boundaries; IANA timezone string.

Billing cycle: Recurring invoice window basis; string.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Billing timezone | Billing cycle |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | UTC | calendar month |

## Tier comparison

The listed billing calendar bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
